#include <iostream>
#include <string>

using namespace std;

int main() {
    int n;
    string s;
    while (cin >> n >> s) {
        int maxOut = 0;
        int curOut = 0;
        int insideWords = 0;
        bool inside = false;
        bool wordStart = true;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            char c = s[i];
            if (c == '(') {
                inside = true;
                wordStart = true;
                curOut = 0;
            } else if (c == ')') {
                inside = false;
                curOut = 0;
            } else if (!inside) {
                if (c == '_') {
                    curOut = 0;
                } else {
                    ++curOut;
                    if (curOut > maxOut) {
                        maxOut = curOut;
                    }
                }
            } else {
                if (c == '_') {
                    wordStart = true;
                } else if (wordStart) {
                    ++insideWords;
                    wordStart = false;
                }
            }
        }
        cout << maxOut << " " << insideWords << endl;
    }
    cout << flush;
    return 0;
}
